name: true seeing
lore:
### The Sight Unveiled: A Treatise on True Seeing

*True Seeing* is no mere divination; it is the violent peeling back of reality’s skin. When a caster shapes the Weave for this rite, they feel a sharp, icy pressure behind the brow, as if the mind is being lanced by a needle of starlight. It is a sensation of agonizing clarity, stripping away the comforting warmth of the mundane.

To an observer, the caster’s pupils dilate into shimmering pools of liquid mercury, reflecting not the room, but the raw quintessence of the cosmos. Under this gaze, the gilded lies of illusions wither like smoke, and the ethereal plane bleeds into the material.

Legend attributes this discovery to the blind oracle Valerius. Besieged by a Fey Prince’s shifting glamours, Valerius did not pray for sight, but for the "weight of truth." He was granted a vision that bypassed the flesh entirely, perceiving the pulse of the universe itself. 

Be warned, initiate: once the veil is lifted, the world may forever seem a pale, hollow mask. To see truly is to carry the burden of all that is hidden.
